title: Arithmetic Progressions
notes: An AP is a list of numbers where each term (after the first) is obtained by adding a fixed number, the common difference d, to the preceding term.
General form: a, a+d, a+2d, a+3d, ... where a is the first term.
d = a(k+1) - a(k) for any consecutive pair -- must be the SAME throughout for it to be an AP. d can be positive, negative, or zero.
To check if a list is an AP: compute differences between consecutive terms; if all equal, it's an AP.
Word problems that are secretly APs: uniform salary increments, simple interest year by year, linear depreciation, seating/row patterns, taxi fare per km, penalty-per-day schemes.

For 'find which term equals X' problems: set an = X and solve for n. For 'find number of terms' with a sum given, you may end up with a quadratic in n -- always REJECT the negative/fractional/non-physical root.
Sn (sum) formulas come in two flavours: use a+(n-1)d version when the last term isn't directly known, use the 'l' (last term) version when it is.

formulas.name: Sum of n terms (from first term & d)
Sum of n terms (from first & last term)
formulas.formula: Sn = n/2 * (a + l), where l = last term
formulas.use: When last term l is directly known.

formulas.name: Relation between Sn and terms
formulas.use: Extract nth term when only the sum formula Sn is given.

examples.question: For the AP 3/2, 1/2, -1/2, -3/2, ... find first term a and common difference d.
Which of these form an AP? (i) 4,10,16,22,... (ii) 1,-1,-3,-5,... (iii) -2,2,-2,2,... (iv) 1,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,3,...
examples.solution: (i) Yes, d=6, next terms 28,34. (ii) Yes, d=-2, next terms -7,-9. (iii) No, differences alternate 4,-4. (iv) No, differences are 0,0,1 -- not constant.

exercises.question: Which situations form an AP: (i) Taxi fare Rs15 first km, Rs8 each additional km. (ii) Air remaining in cylinder when 1/4 removed each time. (iii) Cost of digging a well: Rs150 first metre, rising Rs50 each subsequent metre. (iv) Money in account yearly at 8% compound interest on Rs10000.
exercises.answer: (i) Yes, d=8 (ii) No (geometric, not arithmetic) (iii) Yes, d=50 (iv) No (compound interest is not linear)

exercises.answer: (i) No (ii) Yes d=1/2 (iii) Yes d=-2 (iv) Yes d=4 (v) Yes d=root2 (vi) No (vii) Yes d=-4 (viii) Yes d=0 (ix) No (x) Yes d=a (xi) No (xii) Yes d=root2 (xiii) No (xiv) No (xv) Yes d=24
